_what: The Calendar's keyboard and menu actions on one event that its sources make possible (src/workspace/calendar-key-actions.ts): each row is one context action (its label, its icon, what it does). `source_action` runs the source's own action that names this row as its `command` (src/calendar.json actions), `privacy` flips a private event back to the calendar's default and any other event to private, `color` offers the event colours the source declares (the keys 1 to 9 choose the first nine), `event_done` and `event_reopen` mark an event done or not (offered only while the calendar settings show done boxes on events), `join` opens the event's call. The keys that run them are rows of src/workspace/keymap.json (the calendar rows); the words here are the menu's. A row is shown only for an event whose source can do it.

actions.label: Make private or not
actions.private_said: Private: others see this event as busy.
actions.public_said: Back to the calendar's default privacy.

actions.label: Change color
actions.none: There is no color {number} for this event.
